brief: Competitive-structure intelligence for Slovenia rests on a compact set of legally-mandated registers: AVK merger decisions, Banka Slovenije/ECB qualifying-holding authorisations, ATVP takeover permits and SEOnet regulated disclosures, with SDH/SID covering state disposals and AJPES confirming the resulting ownership. Group-level moves (OTP/Nova KBM/SKB, NLB's Addiko bid, EU-dimension processor deals) surface first in foreign parent newsrooms and EC DG COMP cases, ahead of any Slovenian-language channel. The weakest link is small payment-vendor ownership change, which falls below notification thresholds and is only visible via AJPES/aggregator diffs. Slovenian-language terminology (priglasitev koncentracije, prevzemna ponudba, kvalificiran delež, prodaja deleža, statusne spremembe) is essential — English-only querying misses the primary registers entirely.
